references.prompt:
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: (1) The competitor carousel image referencia-01 controls SCENE, framing, camera angle, subject placement and composition ONLY. (2) The Dear Bron Product Master (attach: the new product's master render or supplier sample photo — to be produced) controls every physical attribute of the product: exact silhouette, webbing texture, hardware finish, proportions, stitching pattern and the brand colour (Charcoal #33352C, Sand #E8DDC9, Moss #7D8A5C or Terracotta #C56A44 as specified per shot).
PRODUCT FIDELITY: reproduce the Dear Bron product exactly from the Product Master. Do NOT reproduce the competitor's brand name, logo, woven label, tag artwork, colourway or any printed claim. The dog, the environment and the light come from the reference; the product does not.
SCENE: still da coleira em fundo neutro.
COMPOSITION: match referencia-01 — same crop ratio, same subject position in frame, same distance, same depth of field.
LENS AND LIGHT: 50mm-equivalent full-frame look, soft overcast daylight, gentle key from the upper left, realistic soft contact shadows; outdoor shots in a British park with wet gravel or grass, indoor/still shots on a seamless warm-neutral backdrop.
MATERIALS: matte nylon webbing with a subtle weave, brushed (not shiny) metal D-rings and buckles, dense neoprene padding, heat-pressed personalised name in a clean humanist sans serif.
ANATOMY: if a dog appears, anatomically correct medium-size breed, natural mid-stride or standing pose, harness sitting correctly on the shoulders with the Y-front clear of the throat, lead line with natural slack.
FORMAT: 2048x2048 px, delivered as WEBP, product centred with safe margin on all sides, no border.
RESTRICTIONS: no text overlays except the pet name where the scene explicitly calls for it; no competitor branding anywhere; no unverifiable claims such as "vet approved" or "guaranteed to stop pulling".
NEGATIVE PROMPT: distorted or twisted straps, extra or missing limbs, floating buckles, duplicated hardware, blurry or warped logo, watermark, text artefacts, plastic-looking metal, oversaturated colours, HDR halo, cartoon or 3D-render look, mannequin dog.
